_comment: Exact body the harness POSTs to http://127.0.0.1:18000/v1/completions. Greedy settings are mandatory: temperature 0 + fixed seed is what makes the paired accuracy statistics valid. stream:true is required to measure TTFT and the inter-token-latency distribution at all.

_notes.model: always the --served-model-name, never the checkpoint id, so the harness need not know which precision arm is loaded
_notes.logprobs: needed for the KL/Jensen-Shannon divergence arm; drop it for pure throughput runs since it adds payload
_notes.stream_options.include_usage: without this the final chunk carries no token counts and per-request throughput cannot be computed
